text:
Counting the almonds in the photo gives roughly 85–95. A whole almond weighs about 1.2 g, so 90 almonds come to about 108 g. Almonds run about 5.8 kcal/g, which gives roughly 620 kcal.

That count looks high for the plate, though. The plate is about 20 cm across and the almonds fill the center in a layer roughly one almond deep. I'll settle on about 90 almonds at 1.2 g each, or around 100 g.

100 g × 5.8 kcal/g ≈ 580 kcal.
